request.subject: CITY:DINOSAUR:3

layers.text: Remove all ground: erase the grass, the soil slab and the row of dark stones along its edge under the camp, so the rib arch, the tents and the hut stand directly on a transparent background with nothing at all under them. Keep the giant cream rib-cage arch, the horned cream skull, the bright red awning and roof, the bright red cone tents, the red flags, the outline and the art style exactly the same.
